message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake. Feel free to adjust quantities or add extras (like espresso powder or sea salt) to suit your taste. | Ingredient | Typical Quantity (for a 9‑inch round cake) | Notes | |------------|-------------------------------------------|-------| | All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb. | | Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Use a high‑quality Dutch‑process or natural cocoa. | | Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | Can be replaced with brown sugar for a richer flavor. | | Baking powder | 1 ½ tsp | Helps the cake rise. | | Baking soda | 1 ½ tsp | Works with acidic cocoa for leavening. | | Salt | 1 ½ tsp | Balances sweetness. | | Eggs | 2 large | Room‑temperature eggs give a smoother batter. | | Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Can substitute with almond or oat milk. | | Vegetable oil (or melted butter) | ½ cup (120 ml) | Oil keeps the cake moist; butter adds flavor. | | Vanilla extract | 2 tsp | Adds depth to the chocolate flavor. | | Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates the cocoa and creates a moist crumb. | | Optional extras | | • 1–2 tbsp espresso powder (enhances chocolate)
• Pinch of sea salt (brightens sweetness)
• ½ cup chocolate chips or chopped nuts (texture) | **Basic Steps:** 1. **Preheat** your oven to 350 °F (175 °C). Grease and flour two 9‑inch round pans (or line with parchment paper). 2. **Mix dry ingredients**: sift flour, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together. 3. **Combine wet ingredients**: whisk eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla in a separate bowl. 4. **Blend**: Add the wet mixture to the dry, mixing until just combined. Stir in boiling water (the batter will be thin—this’s normal). 5. **Bake**: Pour batter evenly into prepared pans. Bake 30–35 min, or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. 6. **Cool**: Let cakes cool in pans for 10 min, then transfer to wire racks to cool completely before frosting. Enjoy your homemade chocolate cake!
